name: Holy Tempest spreads Condemn for every Righteous Tempest rank (#10163)
contract: Holy Tempest 301339 reads "Damage dealt by Righteous Tempest now spreads Condemn on affected enemies to a nearby enemy". Righteous Tempest's castable ranks are the 805409 spell chain (805409 rank 1, 807269 rank 2, per spell_ranks), and each rank triggers its own damage spell through its 3-second periodic buff (Spell.dbc EffectTriggerSpell[0]: rank 1 -> 805410, rank 2 -> 570200; the same ids carry the per-rank coefficients in AscensionTemplarData.h). AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp must therefore recognise the damage spell of every rank, not only rank 1's, both for the talent's Condemn copy and for the buff's Oath Breaker damage bonus. Fixture: one Templar learns 301339, Condemn 567541 and Righteous Tempest rank 1 is cast while it is the only known rank; rank 2 is learned for the reported case. Each phase summons a condemned dummy and a second enemy 1.5 yards away; both stand inside Righteous Tempest's 5 yard area (SpellRadius 8) around the caster, so the cast's damage hits both and the Condemn already on the first dummy must be copied onto the second (spread radius 10 yards). Phase 1 casts rank 1 (damage spell 805410) and is parity for the pre-existing case; phase 2 casts rank 2 (570200) and is the reported case. Phase 3 unlearns 301339, asserts its aura is gone, and repeats phase 2 on a fresh pair: the second enemy must stay free of Condemn, so the copy is what the talent adds.
